units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905
author: Buck Nasty
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones (gb-maps-1): a combat surf map with no finish -- two buyzones, 100-odd weapons on the floor, jail1/jail2/jailbreak destinations and a middle sniper perch. Every trigger_teleport aims back at a spawn, a jail or the top of a ramp, so there is a loop to fight on and no line a run could end at. Not published.
